categories.main_business_segments: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of difficult-to-deform metal ring forgings for aerospace applications, mainly focusing on aero-engine ring forgings. Its products also serve aerospace rocket engines, missiles, marine gas turbines, industrial gas turbines, and other high-end equipment sectors. The company has expanded into gas turbine forgings, aerospace forgings, and other high-end equipment forgings, including emerging fields such as nuclear power, hydrogen energy, and deep-sea equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies including material deformation and microstructure control for high-temperature alloys, low-plasticity material forming surface control, intelligent numerical simulation for process design, and precise stable rolling of complex thin-walled ring forgings. It employs advanced ring rolling and forging techniques, integrated digital process design, and intelligent manufacturing systems. The production model is mainly 'make-to-order' due to customized, non-standardized products with multiple batches and specifications. The company also uses digital twin and AI optimization technologies to enhance product quality and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international aerospace engine manufacturers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney (P&W), Safran, Rolls-Royce, Honeywell, and Collins Aerospace, as well as domestic clients like China Aviation Engine Group and AVIC. The company serves the commercial aviation engine market, gas turbine industry, aerospace rocket engines, nuclear power, hydrogen energy, and deep-sea equipment sectors. Its products are integrated into mainstream commercial aero-engines including LEAP, GE9X, and domestic engines like the Changjiang series.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guiyang, Guizhou Province, and production facilities in Sichuan and other regions. It has a significant international presence, serving global aerospace engine manufacturers and expanding markets in Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Overseas subsidiaries are located in Hong Kong, the British Virgin Islands, and the United States. International business accounted for approximately 45.24% of revenue in 2024, showing strong growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-precision, difficult-to-deform metal ring forgings for aero-engines and other high-end equipment. It is a key tier supplier to major engine manufacturers, providing critical components such as engine casings and turbine parts. The company is expanding vertically by acquiring capabilities in precision machining and component assembly to offer integrated solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with a focus on advanced materials, near-net-shape forming, digital process simulation, and intelligent manufacturing. It invests heavily in R&D, targeting breakthroughs in forming difficult aerospace alloys, process stability, and quality control. Strategic priorities include expanding product applications into gas turbines, nuclear power, hydrogen energy, and deep-sea equipment. The company also pursues global market penetration, digital transformation, and talent development to sustain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized aerospace and high-end equipment metal forgings to domestic and international customers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with long-term supply agreements and strategic contracts with major engine manufacturers. Revenue streams include product sales from aerospace forgings, gas turbine components, and other specialized forgings, with a growing proportion from overseas exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic aerospace ring forging manufacturer with significant international market penetration. It competes with established global aerospace forging firms such as Carlton Forge Works, Doncasters Group, and Howmet Aerospace. While these competitors have integrated full aerospace supply chains, Guizhou Aviation focuses on high-quality, difficult-to-deform metal ring forgings and is recognized as a key supplier in the Asia-Pacific region. It holds multiple certifications and long-term contracts with top global engine manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.805 billion, a 14.19% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to domestic customer delivery adjustments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 188.6 million, a slight increase of 1.63%. Total assets grew by 25.75% to RMB 4.29 billion, driven by convertible bond issuance and new project investments. The company maintains stable cash flow and has a net asset base of RMB 1.83 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies in difficult-to-deform aerospace alloy forging, enabling high-quality, precise, and reliable ring forgings critical for aero-engines and other high-end equipment. Its integrated digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities reduce costs and improve product consistency. Long-term strategic partnerships with global aerospace giants and certifications such as NADCAP and AS9100D underpin its competitive advantage. The company’s ability to customize products for complex specifications and maintain stable supply relationships offers unique value to customers.
